summary: Trillion Energy International Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, announcing a non-brokered private placement of up to 13,333,333 units at CAD$0.15 per unit for gross proceeds of up to CAD$2 million, and a 5:1 share consolidation. Each unit consists of one common share and one-half warrant (exercisable at CAD$0.25 for one year). Proceeds will fund work obligations on the M47 Concession, IR activities, and general working capital. The offering is subject to CSE approval and is available under prospectus exemptions. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
